resources.string: Chores, pocket money and screen time, shared between the family’s phones.
Set up your household, or join it from another phone
Link it with a code from a parent’s phone
Sign in with the Google account you want to manage the household with.
Debug build: sign in to the local Firebase emulator. A new e-mail address creates a test account.
Money in your household is counted in this currency. It can’t be changed later.
Your trial data stays on this phone until you continue; it will be deleted.
The kids, chores, rewards and balances you tried Sprout with are not copied into your household.
The kids, chores, rewards and balances tried on this phone are not copied. The phone gets everything from the household instead.
Approve this device on your other phone
On a phone that already runs your household, open the dashboard or Settings → Devices and approve the new device. Check that it shows this code:
On a parent’s phone, open Settings → Kids, pick the kid and choose “Link a device”.
Codes are single-use and expire after 10 minutes.
